title: The most important question at TIFF: what was it like working with th...
transcript: Whatever Brad Pitt is going on with that dog in that film, that is not what happened here. This dog would not sit. It would move it. All it needed to do was sit, and it wouldn't sit. And the editor, the editor, fantastic job because he kept him still. But that dog was a diva of a nightmare. And was also doing Bridgerton and something else. And it was just swanning around. It was a total nightmare. Asshole on the dog.
